findings.description: The bucket is documented as public with no bucket policy or public access block restricting access, exposing its contents (including a customer master file) to unauthenticated internet access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest by default.
A customer master data file (customer-master.xlsx) is uploaded into the publicly accessible, unencrypted aws_s3_bucket.data bucket, exposing sensitive customer data.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket holding financial data, so objects are stored unencrypted.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, leaving operations data stored unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, leaving data science bucket contents unencrypted at rest.
